project_type: Python FastAPI Document Management System with RAG/LLM Wiki pipeline
build_system: uv (package manager), pyproject.toml for project config
test_framework: pytest with httpx (AsyncClient for FastAPI testing)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'uv sync' to install dependencies. 2. Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -v' to run all tests. 3. Run 'uv run ruff check src/' for linting. 4. Run 'uv run python -c "from app.main import app"' to verify import.
setup_instructions: 1. Set Python 3.11 via pyenv: 'pyenv local 3.11.15'. 2. Initialize project: 'uv init'. 3. Install deps: 'uv sync'.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Python 3.11.15 via pyenv. uv available as package manager. No Docker daemon confirmed yet.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - establishing conventions: src layout with app/ package, ruff for linting, pytest for testing, type hints throughout.
key_patterns: FastAPI app factory pattern, SQLAlchemy async with SQLite, Pydantic models for API schemas, dependency injection for services, background tasks for pipeline processing
directory_structure: app/ - main application package. app/api/ - route handlers. app/models/ - SQLAlchemy models. app/schemas/ - Pydantic schemas. app/services/ - business logic (pipeline, wiki, rag). app/core/ - config, security, database. tests/ - pytest tests. wiki/ - LLM wiki output directory. storage/ - uploaded and processed files.
